s0201.literal: On jingzi day [25] the emperor's younger brother Shurong was made Prince of Xinchang and Shukuang Prince of Taiyuan.
s0201.idiomatic: On jingzi day [25] the emperor's younger brother Shurong was made prince of Xinchang and Shukuang prince of Taiyuan.

s0202.literal: That month Sui sent Prince of Jin Guang with a host of armies to attack; from Ba, Shu, Mian, and Han they came downriver to Guangling; several tens of routes entered together, and the garrisons along the Yangtze reported in succession.
s0202.idiomatic: That month Sui sent the Prince of Jin, Guang, at the head of many armies to attack; from Ba, Shu, the Mian, and the Han they descended to Guangling along several dozen routes at once, and river garrisons reported one after another.

s0203.literal: At that time the newly appointed Inspector of Xiangzhou Shi Wenqing and Secretariat Attendant Shen Keqing held confidential power; both suppressed the reports and did not speak, so there was no defense.
s0203.idiomatic: At that time the newly appointed Xiangzhou inspector Shi Wenqing and secretariat attendant Shen Keqing held confidential power; both suppressed the reports and said nothing, so the court was unprepared.

s0204.literal: In the first month of spring of year 3, on yichou the new moon, mist filled on all sides.
s0204.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of year 3, on yichou the new moon, mist closed in on every side.

s0205.literal: That day Sui Inspector-General He Ruo Bi from the northern route crossed from Guangling to Jingkou; Inspector-General Han Qin Hu pressed toward Hengjiang, [26] crossed Caishi, and from the southern route was to join Bi's army.
s0205.idiomatic: That day Sui inspector-general He Ruo Bi from the northern route crossed from Guangling to Jingkou; inspector-general Han Qin Hu pressed toward Hengjiang, [26] crossed Caishi, and from the south was to join Bi's army.

s0206.literal: On yinyin day the Caishi garrison commander Xu Zijian galloped in with urgent news of the change.
s0206.idiomatic: On yinyin day Caishi garrison commander Xu Zijian galloped in with urgent news.

s0207.literal: On dingmao day the emperor summoned the high ministers to discuss military affairs.
s0207.idiomatic: On dingmao day the emperor summoned the high ministers to discuss military affairs.

s0208.literal: On wuchen day inner and outer defenses were ordered; Cavalry General Xiao Mohe, [27] Protector of the Army Fan Yi, and Central Army Commander Lu Guangda were all made commanders; Southern Yuzhou Inspector Fan Meng was sent to lead the fleet out from Baixia; Regular Attendant Gao Wenzou was to lead troops and garrison Southern Yuzhou.
s0208.idiomatic: On wuchen day inner and outer defenses were ordered; cavalry general Xiao Mohe, [27] protector of the army Fan Yi, and central army commander Lu Guangda were all made commanders; Southern Yuzhou inspector Fan Meng led the fleet out from Baixia; regular attendant Gao Wenzou was to lead troops and garrison Southern Yuzhou.

s0209.literal: On gengwu day He Ruo Bi stormed and took Southern Xuzhou.
s0209.idiomatic: On gengwu day He Ruo Bi stormed and took Southern Xuzhou.

s0210.literal: On xinwei day Han Qin Hu again took Southern Yuzhou; Wenzou was defeated and returned.
s0210.idiomatic: On xinwei day Han Qin Hu again took Southern Yuzhou; Wenzou was defeated and returned.

s0211.literal: By then the Sui armies on north and south routes were advancing together.
s0211.idiomatic: By then the Sui armies on north and south routes were advancing together.

s0212.literal: Houzhu sent Cavalry Grand General and Minister of Works Prince of Yuzhang Shuying to garrison Chao
s0212.idiomatic: Houzhu sent cavalry grand general and minister of works Shuying, Prince of Yuzhang, to garrison Chao

s0214.literal: [tang], [28] Xiao Mohe garrisoned the Pleasure Gardens, Fan Yi the Jataka Temple, Lu Guangda White Earth Mound, and Loyal-and-Martial General Kong Fan the Baotian Temple.
s0214.idiomatic: [tang], [28] Xiao Mohe garrisoned the Pleasure Gardens, Fan Yi the Jataka Temple, Lu Guangda White Earth Mound, and loyal-and-martial general Kong Fan the Baotian Temple.

s0215.literal: On jimao day Pacify-the-East Grand General Ren Zhong came in from Wuxing and still garrisoned the Vermilion Bird Gate.
s0215.idiomatic: On jimao day pacify-the-east grand general Ren Zhong came in from Wuxing and still garrisoned the Vermilion Bird Gate.

s0216.literal: On xinsi day He Ruo Bi advanced and held Bell Mountain, encamped southeast of White Earth Mound.
s0216.idiomatic: On xinsi day He Ruo Bi advanced and held Bell Mountain, encamped southeast of White Earth Mound.

s0217.literal: On jiashen day Houzhu sent the mass of armies to join battle with Bi; the armies were routed.
s0217.idiomatic: On jiashen day Houzhu sent the mass of armies to join battle with Bi; the armies were routed.

s0218.literal: Bi pressed the victory to the Pleasure Gardens; Lu Guangda still directed scattered troops in fierce fighting but could not resist.
s0218.idiomatic: Bi pressed the victory to the Pleasure Gardens; Lu Guangda still directed scattered troops in fierce fighting but could not resist.

s0219.literal: Bi attacked the palace city and burned the North Side Gate.
s0219.idiomatic: Bi attacked the palace city and burned the North Side Gate.

s0220.literal: At that time Han Qin Hu led his host from Xinlin to Shizi Mound; Ren Zhong went out and surrendered to Qin Hu, then led Qin Hu by the Vermilion Bird crossing toward the palace city and entered by the South Side Gate.
s0220.idiomatic: At that time Han Qin Hu led his host from Xinlin to Shizi Mound; Ren Zhong went out and surrendered to Qin Hu, then led Qin Hu by the Vermilion Bird crossing toward the palace city and entered by the South Side Gate.

s0221.literal: Then the civil and military hundred offices within the city all fled out; only Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Xian remained in the hall.
s0221.idiomatic: Then the civil and military hundred offices within the city all fled; only vice director of the masters of writing Yuan Xian remained in the hall.

s0222.literal: Director of the Masters of Writing Jiang Zong, Minister of Personnel Yao Cha, Minister of Revenue Yuan Quan, former Minister of Revenue Wang Yuan, and Palace Attendant Wang Kuan stayed in the Secretariat.
s0222.idiomatic: Director of the masters of writing Jiang Zong, minister of personnel Yao Cha, minister of revenue Yuan Quan, former minister of revenue Wang Yuan, and palace attendant Wang Kuan stayed in the secretariat.

s0223.literal: When Houzhu heard the army had come, he went out from the rear hall Jingyang Pavilion with a dozen palace women and was about to throw himself into a well; Yuan Xian attended at his side and bitterly remonstrated but he would not listen; Rear-Gate Attendant Xia Hou Gongyun again covered the well with his body; Houzhu struggled with him a long time before he could enter.
s0223.idiomatic: When Houzhu heard the army had come, he went out from the rear-hall Jingyang Pavilion with a dozen palace women and was about to throw himself into a well; Yuan Xian at his side bitterly remonstrated but he would not listen; rear-gate attendant Xia Hou Gongyun again covered the well with his body; Houzhu struggled with him a long time before he could enter.

s0224.literal: By night he was seized by the Sui army.
s0224.idiomatic: By night he was seized by the Sui army.

s0225.literal: On jingxu day Prince of Jin Guang entered and held the capital.
s0225.idiomatic: On jingxu day the Prince of Jin, Guang, entered and held the capital.

s0226.literal: On jisi day of the third month Houzhu with the kings, dukes, and hundred offices set out from Jiankang and entered Chang'an.
s0226.idiomatic: On jisi day of the third month Houzhu with the kings, dukes, and hundred offices set out from Jiankang and entered Chang'an.

s0227.literal: In the eleventh month of Renshou year 4 of Sui, on renzi day, he died at Luoyang, aged fifty-two.
s0227.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Sui Renshou year 4, on renzi day, he died at Luoyang, aged fifty-two.

s0228.literal: Posthumously he was given Grand General and enfeoffed as Duke of the Chief Wall county; his posthumous title was Yang; he was buried on Mang Mountain in Henan, Luoyang.
s0228.idiomatic: Posthumously he was given grand general and enfeoffed as duke of Chief Wall county; his posthumous title was Yang; he was buried on Mang Mountain at Luoyang in Henan.

s0229.literal: The historian, Palace Attendant and Duke of Zheng Wei Zheng, said:
s0229.idiomatic: The historian, palace attendant and Duke of Zheng Wei Zheng, said:

s0230.literal: The High Ancestor rose from the furrow with a heroic mettle.
s0230.idiomatic: The High Ancestor rose from the furrow with heroic mettle.

s0231.literal: At first he aided a lower fief and deployed singular strategy; he held his staff in the southern sea with the charge to still disorder.
s0231.idiomatic: At first he aided a lower fief and deployed singular strategy; he held his staff in the southern sea charged to still disorder.

s0232.literal: He raised his banner northward with the righteousness of aiding the throne, swept Hou Jing when already formed, and rescued the Liang house when already fallen.
s0232.idiomatic: He raised his banner northward in righteousness to aid the throne, swept Hou Jing when already formed, and rescued the Liang house when already fallen.

s0233.literal: Heaven's net, broken, was joined again; the state's step, halted, grew tranquil again; the hundred spirits had a lord and the old realm was not lost.
s0233.idiomatic: Heaven's net, broken, was joined again; the state's step, halted, grew tranquil again; the hundred spirits had a lord and the old realm was not lost.

s0234.literal: The King of Wei's prolonging the Han tripod and Song Wu's turning back the Jin imperial carriage—such great deeds and splendid merit have nothing above them.
s0234.idiomatic: The King of Wei's prolonging the Han tripod and Song Wu's turning back the Jin imperial carriage—such great deeds and splendid merit have nothing above them.

s0235.literal: At that time inner strife was not yet stilled and outer neighbors were fierce foes; Wang Lin made obstruction on the upper reaches and Zhou and Qi shook the Jiang and Han—fearing head and tail as if existing yet not existing—to shift the heavenly mandate without planning this, though the imperial numen had regard, how swift it was!
s0235.idiomatic: At that time inner strife was not yet stilled and outer neighbors were fierce foes; Wang Lin made obstruction on the upper reaches and Zhou and Qi shook the Jiang and Han—fearing head and tail as if existing yet not existing—to shift the heavenly mandate without planning this, though the imperial numen had regard, how swift it was!

s0236.literal: Yet his will and measure were broad and far, his breast open as if level; he took men from among foes and raised talent from among fugitives, covered their taking-gold faults and pardoned their barking-at-Yao crimes, entrusted them as heart, belly, claws, and teeth, and all could give him their utmost strength—thus he decided the hundred battles and formed this tripartite realm; compared with the heroes of the tripod age he need not blush before Cao and Liu.
s0236.idiomatic: Yet his will and measure were broad and far, his breast open as if level; he took men from among foes and raised talent from among fugitives, covered their taking-gold faults and pardoned their barking-at-Yao crimes, entrusted them as heart, belly, claws, and teeth, and all could give him their utmost strength—thus he decided the hundred battles and formed this tripartite realm; compared with the heroes of the tripod age he need not blush before Cao and Liu.

s0237.literal: Emperor Wen by nature was wise and penetrating, with clarity in his person; early he took part in ordering the realm and knew the people's hardship; he thought to choose good statutes and nearly reach supreme order.
s0237.idiomatic: Emperor Wen by nature was wise and penetrating, with clarity in his person; early he took part in ordering the realm and knew the people's hardship; he thought to choose good statutes and nearly reach supreme order.

s0238.literal: Virtue and punishments were used together; he cut through hard times, the fierce all offered their heads, and strong neighbors were shaken in awe.
s0238.idiomatic: Virtue and punishments were used together; he cut through hard times, the fierce all offered their heads, and strong neighbors were shaken in awe.

s0239.literal: Though the transformation of generous loyalty did not reach far, the wind of respectful frugality was enough to leave instruction; had he not prized sharp discernment, he would have been a good lord who kept the written rule.
s0239.idiomatic: Though the transformation of generous loyalty did not reach far, the wind of respectful frugality was enough to leave instruction; had he not prized sharp discernment, he would have been a good lord who kept the written rule.

s0240.literal: The Deposed Emperor was older than the Duke of Zhou of Cheng's time and went too far beyond the Duke of Taijia.
s0240.idiomatic: The Deposed Emperor was older than the Duke of Zhou of Cheng's time and went too far beyond the Duke of Taijia.

s0241.literal: Emperor Xuan had the Duke of Zhou's kinship but not the Duke of Yin's intent; the enlightened ruler did not return, and the Tung Palace went on—wishing to add guilt to him, was there no plea?
s0241.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan had the Duke of Zhou's kinship but not the Duke of Yin's intent; the enlightened ruler did not return, and the Tung Palace went on—wishing to add guilt to him, was there no plea?

s0242.literal: Emperor Xuan, from the time he was in the fields, had a generous measure and broad forbearance; ascending to rule the summit, the people returned to his depth.
s0242.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan, from the time he was in the fields, had a generous measure and broad forbearance; ascending to rule the summit, the people returned to his depth.

s0243.literal: He was kind in employing those below, [29] and broad in containing the multitude.
s0243.idiomatic: He was kind in employing those below, [29] and broad in containing the multitude.

s0244.literal: Wisdom and courage vied in ardor; the army went out with a righteous name; banners were raised and commands divided—the wind moved and lightning swept; a thousand li of territory was opened and Huai and Si were suddenly held—the momentum of victory in attack in recent antiquity had never been its like.
s0244.idiomatic: Wisdom and courage vied in ardor; the army went out with a righteous name; banners were raised and commands divided—the wind moved and lightning swept; a thousand li of territory was opened and Huai and Si were suddenly held—the momentum of victory in attack in recent antiquity had never been its like.

s0245.literal: [30] Afterward the lord was extravagant and the people weary; generals were proud and soldiers slack; the treasury was empty and the army was broken—then the Qin people grew strong and looked with troops upon the Yangtze.
s0245.idiomatic: [30] Afterward the lord was extravagant and the people weary; generals were proud and soldiers slack; the treasury was empty and the army was broken—then the Qin people grew strong and looked with troops upon the Yangtze.

s0246.literal: Li Ke held that Wu perished first because of many battles [many victories], [31] for many battles weary the people and many victories make the lord proud; with a proud lord ruling weary people, none have not perished.
s0246.idiomatic: Li Ke held that Wu perished first because of many battles [many victories], [31] for many battles weary the people and many victories make the lord proud; with a proud lord ruling weary people, none have not perished.

s0248.literal: Emperor Xuan at first won men by generosity and at the end failed by pride and extravagance; the civil and military enterprise [32] fell away at this.
s0248.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan at first won men by generosity and at the end failed by pride and extravagance; the civil and military enterprise [32] fell away at this.

s0249.literal: Houzhu was born deep in the palace and grew up in women's hands; when he came to a realm in ruin he did not know the hardship of sowing and reaping.
s0249.idiomatic: Houzhu was born deep in the palace and grew up in women's hands; when he came to a realm in ruin he did not know the hardship of sowing and reaping.

s0250.literal: At first he feared imminent peril and repeatedly issued edicts of pity; later, when things were somewhat settled, he again fanned the wind of lewd extravagance.
s0250.idiomatic: At first he feared imminent peril and repeatedly issued edicts of pity; later, when things were somewhat settled, he again fanned the wind of lewd extravagance.

s0251.literal: In guest-ritual toward the lords he entrusted feeling only to letters and wine; in intimacy with petty men he entrusted them all with the pivot of power.
s0251.idiomatic: In guest-ritual toward the lords he entrusted feeling only to letters and wine; in intimacy with petty men he entrusted them all with the pivot of power.

s0252.literal: Where counsel reached, there were no ministers with backbone; where power lay, there were none but officials who preyed and stripped.
s0252.idiomatic: Where counsel reached, there were no ministers with backbone; where power lay, there were none but officials who preyed and stripped.

s0253.literal: Government and punishments daily fell into disorder; dead wood filled the court; he indulged in drinking through the long night and favored concubines like the wickedness of a beautiful wife; peril and ruin he did not grieve; above and below deceived one another; the multitude rebelled and kin departed; facing the moment he did not awaken and threw himself into a well, hoping to live a little longer—to look on him seeking safety thus is to be beneath the people indeed.
s0253.idiomatic: Government and punishments daily fell into disorder; dead wood filled the court; he indulged in drinking through the long night and favored concubines like the wickedness of a beautiful wife; peril and ruin he did not grieve; above and below deceived one another; the multitude rebelled and kin departed; facing the moment he did not awaken and threw himself into a well, hoping to live a little longer—to look on him seeking safety thus is to be beneath the people indeed.

s0254.literal: Looking far at the ranks of rulers who succeeded to martial glory, at the start they all wished to align brightness with sun and moon, join virtue with heaven and earth, look down on the Five Emperors and look up to harmonize with the Three Kings—yet scarcely none lacked a beginning while few could keep the end; what is the reason?
s0254.idiomatic: Looking far at the ranks of rulers who succeeded to martial glory, at the start they all wished to align brightness with sun and moon, join virtue with heaven and earth, look down on the Five Emperors and look up to harmonize with the Three Kings—yet scarcely none lacked a beginning while few could keep the end; what is the reason?

s0255.literal: All alike had mediocre talent and a nature that could be shifted; the mouth stored benevolence and righteousness while the heart feared in appetite and desire.
s0255.idiomatic: All alike had mediocre talent and a nature that could be shifted; the mouth stored benevolence and righteousness while the heart feared in appetite and desire.

s0256.literal: Benevolence and righteousness benefit things but the Way is far; appetite and desire follow nature and are convenient to the body.
s0256.idiomatic: Benevolence and righteousness benefit things but the Way is far; appetite and desire follow nature and are convenient to the body.

s0257.literal: Convenience to the body cannot long be left; the distant Way is hard to fix the will upon.
s0257.idiomatic: Convenience to the body cannot long be left; the distant Way is hard to fix the will upon.

s0258.literal: The class of flatterers, receiving the countenance and watching the color, according to what was loved guided with delight—as if going down a slope with a rolling pellet, like opening a dam along the current.
s0258.idiomatic: The class of flatterers, receiving the countenance and watching the color, according to what was loved guided with delight—as if going down a slope with a rolling pellet, like opening a dam along the current.

s0259.literal: Unless one was moved by the numinous and the asterisms above and heaven sent down bright virtue, who could leave what he delighted in and take the hundred surnames as his heart?
s0259.idiomatic: Unless one was moved by the numinous and the asterisms above and heaven sent down bright virtue, who could leave what he delighted in and take the hundred surnames as his heart?

s0260.literal: This is why Cheng, Kang, Wen, and Jing are rarely met in a thousand years while Gui, Xin, You, and Li are in no generation absent—poison reaching the ancestral altars, the person meeting disgrace and punishment, becoming the laughter of the realm: can it not pain one!
s0260.idiomatic: This is why Cheng, Kang, Wen, and Jing are rarely met in a thousand years while Gui, Xin, You, and Li are in no generation absent—poison reaching the ancestral altars, the person meeting disgrace and punishment, becoming the laughter of the realm: can it not pain one!

s0261.literal: The ancients had a saying that lords of perished states often had many talents in the arts; examining Liang, Chen, and Sui, it is truly no empty remark.
s0261.idiomatic: The ancients had a saying that lords of perished states often had many talents in the arts; examining Liang, Chen, and Sui, it is truly no empty remark.

s0262.literal: Yet if one does not honor the root of teaching and righteousness but leans to the partial in lewd and ornate letters, one only lengthens the wind of shallow falsity and cannot save the disaster of disorder and ruin.
s0262.idiomatic: Yet if one does not honor the root of teaching and righteousness but leans to the partial in lewd and ornate letters, one only lengthens the wind of shallow falsity and cannot save the disaster of disorder and ruin.

s0263.literal: The historian says: Houzhu in the eastern palace early bore excellent virtue, and when he faced south and succeeded to the enterprise he truly fulfilled heaven and man's expectation.
s0263.idiomatic: The historian says: Houzhu in the eastern palace early bore excellent virtue, and when he faced south and succeeded to the enterprise he truly fulfilled heaven and man's expectation.

s0264.literal: As for ritual, music, punishments, and government, all followed the old statutes; moreover he deeply extended the six arts and broadly opened the four gates—thus those awaiting edicts vied to reach the Golden Horse, and scholars of antiquarian learning gathered like clouds at the Stone Canal.
s0264.idiomatic: As for ritual, music, punishments, and government, all followed the old statutes; moreover he deeply extended the six arts and broadly opened the four gates—thus those awaiting edicts vied to reach the Golden Horse, and scholars of antiquarian learning gathered like clouds at the Stone Canal.

s0265.literal: Moreover they climbed mountains and crossed seas; those coming to court with tribute often arrived each year.
s0265.idiomatic: Moreover they climbed mountains and crossed seas; those coming to court with tribute often arrived each year.

s0266.literal: From Wei Zhengshi and Jin's middle court onward, though among honored ministers there were those who knew governance, all treated one another by letters and learning and rarely touched common affairs; court regulations and great statutes were for the most part discussed in council, while documents and ledgers were all entrusted to petty clerks—gradually it became custom, down to Chen.
s0266.idiomatic: From Wei Zhengshi and Jin's middle court onward, though among honored ministers there were those who knew governance, all treated one another by letters and learning and rarely touched common affairs; court regulations and great statutes were for the most part discussed in council, while documents and ledgers were all entrusted to petty clerks—gradually it became custom, down to Chen.

s0267.literal: Houzhu followed along and had no leisure to reform; thus Shi Wenqing, Shen Keqing, and their kind solely held the crucial affairs of army and state—wicked and crafty in left ways, they took harsh exaction as merit, sought their own body's glory, and did not preserve the state's plan; therefore court discipline fell in ruin and disaster arose from a neighboring state.
s0267.idiomatic: Houzhu followed along and had no leisure to reform; thus Shi Wenqing, Shen Keqing, and their kind solely held the crucial affairs of army and state—wicked and crafty in left ways, they took harsh exaction as merit, sought their own body's glory, and did not preserve the state's plan; therefore court discipline fell in ruin and disaster arose from a neighboring state.

s0268.literal: This too was the cycle's bell at one hundred six and the tripod jade's shift of change—not only human affairs were unprosperous; it was largely heaven's intent.
s0268.idiomatic: This too was the cycle's bell at one hundred six and the tripod jade's shift of change—not only human affairs were unprosperous; it was largely heaven's intent.

s0270.literal: Right Guard General Xiao Mohe as Chariots-and-Cavalry General and Southern Xuzhou Inspector—note: in Xiao Mohe's biography, when Houzhu succeeded, Mohe for his merit was made Regular Attendant and Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry; here the character "grand" is missing.
s0270.idiomatic: On "right guard general Xiao Mohe as chariots-and-cavalry general and Southern Xuzhou inspector": in Xiao Mohe's biography, when Houzhu succeeded, Mohe for merit was made regular attendant and grand general of chariots and cavalry; grand is missing here.

s0271.literal: Again, appointment as Southern Xuzhou Inspector came after he was Chariots-and-Cavalry General; they were not at the same time.
s0271.idiomatic: Again, appointment as Southern Xuzhou inspector came after he was chariots-and-cavalry general; they were not simultaneous.

s0272.literal: Pacify-the-South General and Inspector of Yu Province Ren Zhong advanced to Pacify-the-South General—note:
s0272.idiomatic: On "pacify-the-south general and Yu Province inspector Ren Zhong advanced to pacify-the-south general": note:

s0274.literal: , in the twelfth year of Taikian he made Regular Attendant and Left Guard General Ren Zhong Pacify-the-South General and Southern Yuzhou Inspector, matching his main biography.
s0274.idiomatic: , in Taikian year 12 he made regular attendant and left guard general Ren Zhong pacify-the-south general and Southern Yuzhou inspector, matching his main biography.

s0275.literal: When Houzhu succeeded, on this basis he was advanced to Pacify-the-South General.
s0275.idiomatic: When Houzhu succeeded, on this basis he was advanced to pacify-the-south general.

s0276.literal: Above "Yu Province" one character "south" is missing.
s0276.idiomatic: Above Yu Province the character south has dropped out.

s0277.literal: Establishing younger brother Shuzhong as Prince of Shixing—"Shuzhong" in the Southern History Annals of Houzhu reads "Shudun," yet
s0277.idiomatic: On "establishing younger brother Shuzhong as Prince of Shixing": the Southern History annals of Houzhu read Shudun, yet

s0280.literal: The emperor's younger brother Shushen as Prince of Yueyang—character "prince" was originally a lacuna in the ink; supplied according to all editions.
s0280.idiomatic: On "the emperor's younger brother Shushen as Prince of Yueyang": prince was a lacuna in the ink; supplied per all editions.

s0281.literal: The emperor's younger brother Shuxiong as Prince of Bashan—"Shuxiong" matches the Southern History Annals of Houzhu,
s0281.idiomatic: On "the emperor's younger brother Shuxiong as Prince of Bashan": Shuxiong matches the Southern History annals of Houzhu,

s0284.literal: Assist-the-Right General and Central Army Commander Prince of Luling Boren advanced to Secure-the-Front General—"Assist-the-Right General" should follow
s0284.idiomatic: On "assist-the-right general and central army commander Prince of Luling Boren advanced to secure-the-front general": assist-the-right general should follow

s0286.literal: the twelfth year of Taikian and

s0287.literal: 〈Biographies of the Nine Princes of Emperor Wen〉
s0287.idiomatic: 〈Biographies of the Nine Princes of Emperor Wen〉

s0290.literal: [eight] talents could not arrive—changed according to Qian Daxin's statement.
s0290.idiomatic: [eight] talents could not arrive—changed per Qian Daxin's statement.

s0291.literal: Note: by Han regulation the emperor at winter and summer solstice regularly faced the front hall and assembled the eight-talent gentlemen to display the eight sounds.
s0291.idiomatic: Note: by Han regulation the emperor at winter and summer solstice regularly faced the front hall and assembled the eight-talent gentlemen to display the eight sounds.

s0292.literal: See the Rites Treatise in the Book of Han.
s0292.idiomatic: See the Rites Treatise in the Book of Han.

s0295.literal: [shen] dawn fixed thought—all editions alike are corrupt; changed according to the Hall edition's textual verification.
s0295.idiomatic: [shen] dawn fixed thought—all editions alike are corrupt; changed per the Hall edition's textual verification.

s0296.literal: Note: "Alone from shen dawn I do not sleep" appears in the Songs of Chu.
s0296.idiomatic: Note: "Alone from shen dawn I do not sleep" appears in the Songs of Chu.

s0297.literal: Jing night lessened the breast—"Jing" in the Northern Supervisory and Hall editions reads "bing."
s0297.idiomatic: On "jing night lessened the breast": jing in the Northern Supervisory and Hall editions reads bing.

s0298.literal: Note: because Sima Ssu-chien avoided Tang taboo, all characters "bing" were changed to "jing"; those reading "bing" are later people's reversal.
s0298.idiomatic: Note: because Sima Ssu-chien avoided Tang taboo, all characters bing were changed to jing; bing readings are later reversals.

s0299.literal: Pacify-the-South General and Inspector of Yu Province Lu Guangda advanced to Pacify-the-South General—note: Lu Guangda in the previous year was Southern Yuzhou Inspector; above "Yu Province" one character "south" is missing.
s0299.idiomatic: On "pacify-the-south general and Yu Province inspector Lu Guangda advanced to pacify-the-south general": Lu Guangda in the previous year was Southern Yuzhou inspector; south above Yu Province has dropped out.
